parts.text: NOT TO SCALE 4 cm 6 cm The diagram shows a child’s toy made of a cone joined to a hemisphere. The cone and the hemisphere each have a radius of 4 cm. The perpendicular height of the cone is 6 cm.

parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) Each cubic centimetre of the hemisphere has a mass of 7.85 g. Each cubic centimetre of the cone has a mass of 0.65 g. Find the total mass of the toy. .................................................. g [2]

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) The height of the cone on a similar toy is 9 cm. Find the total surface area of this toy. ..............................................cm 2 [2]
